# Exit Shortcut

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Exits the shortcut. This works like a return function basically. You can return a value if you place a variable in the parameters.

## Syntax

~~~~text
exit(var: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
exit(var: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
